characters.summary: Model Prime Iron Man uses programmable nanobots stored within housing units to instantly morph into any specialized weapon, shield, or alternate armor configuration on command.

weaknesses: Vulnerable to magnetic manipulation and advanced technopathy
limitations: Nanites can be exhausted or disrupted by high-intensity energy drain

notableResults.note: Fought to a standstill using adaptive weapon configurations.

limitations: Total mass of nanites restricts the size and number of simultaneous constructs

sources.supports: Details on MCU Iron Man suit iterations including Infinity War Mark L.

feats.claim: Drew a single drop of blood from Thanos using sustained nanotech blade and repulsor combos.

notableResults.note: Fought individually against Thanos but was ultimately overpowered and stabbed.
